items.title: Bitcoin Cycle Drawdowns: Peak-to-Trough Recovery Patterns
items.description: Bitcoin's peak-to-trough drawdowns by cycle, plotted by days since each cycle's peak: 2011, 2013, 2017 and 2021 cycles against the current cycle that began at the Oct 6, 2025 high.
items.reason: Bitcoin slipped back to about $59,000 this morning after failing to hold $60,000, so the current cycle's drawdown is deepening. This shows how it compares with past bear markets.

items.title: Average acquisition cost: spot ETFs vs. companies
items.description: Average acquisition cost of bitcoin for US spot ETFs, iShares IBIT, all public companies and Strategy, against the BTC price.
items.reason: With BTC near $59,000, the price sits below the average cost of ETFs and treasury companies. Strategy's own average is $75,446 per coin after this week's 457 BTC buy.

items.title: Waymo vs Tesla in Texas
items.description: Driverless vehicles registered with the Texas DMV for Waymo and Tesla since late May 2026. In the chart's latest data Tesla had 1,507 (Nov 17) vs Waymo's 1,328 (Nov 18).
items.reason: Tesla registered 49 more Cybercabs in Texas overnight, taking its reported fleet to 1,556 vs Waymo's 1,405, widening the lead it took last week.

items.title: SpaceX valuation: private tenders → xAI merger → IPO → market
items.description: SpaceX's valuation path from 2024 private tenders through the Feb 2026 xAI merger, the June 2026 IPO, its peak and low closes, and the Oct 20, 2026 close.
items.reason: Reports today say Tesla and SpaceX have named board members and banks to weigh a potential merger, putting SpaceX's valuation back in focus.

items.title: GPU rental prices, on-demand ($/GPU-hour)
items.description: On-demand GPU rental prices in dollars per GPU-hour for Nvidia B200, H200 SXM, H100 SXM, H100 PCIe and A100 SXM 80GB, since August 2026.
items.reason: New reports say SpaceX's AI unit now earns more than half its revenue renting compute to rivals like Anthropic and Google, so the price of renting a GPU matters.
